07_data_quality_checks.CheckName: Delivered payment amount differs from merchandise plus freight

query_sql.warehouse_counts: SELECT s.name SchemaName,t.name TableName,SUM(p.rows) [RowCount] FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE s.name IN ('dw','stg') GROUP BY s.name,t.name ORDER BY s.name,t.name
query_sql.load_history: SELECT LoadID,Status FROM audit.LoadRun ORDER BY LoadID
query_sql.foreign_keys: SELECT COUNT(*) DeclaredForeignKeys,SUM(CONVERT(int,is_not_trusted)) Untrusted,SUM(CONVERT(int,is_disabled)) Disabled FROM sys.foreign_keys
query_sql.delivery: SELECT COUNT(*) DeliveredOrders,SUM(CONVERT(int,OnTimeEligible)) OnTimeEligible,SUM(CASE WHEN IsOnTime=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeOrders,SUM(CASE WHEN IsOnTime=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LateOrders,SUM(CONVERT(int,DurationEligible)) DurationEligible,AVG(DeliveryDurationDays) AverageDurationDays,AVG(CASE WHEN IsOnTime=0 THEN CONVERT(decimal(20,10),DATEDIFF(day,EstimatedDeliveryTimestamp,ActualDeliveryTimestamp)) END) AverageLateDelayDays,AVG(CASE WHEN SalesEligible=1 AND ItemCount>0 THEN FreightAmount END) AverageFreightPerSalesOrder FROM dw.FactOrders o JOIN dw.DimOrderStatus s ON s.OrderStatusKey=o.OrderStatusKey WHERE s.OrderStatus='delivered'
query_sql.reviews: SELECT COUNT(*) ValidReviews,AVG(CONVERT(decimal(20,10),ReviewScore)) AverageScore,SUM(CASE WHEN ReviewScore>=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) PositiveReviews,SUM(CASE WHEN ReviewScore<=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) NegativeReviews,SUM(CASE WHEN ReviewScore=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FiveStarReviews,COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) ReviewedOrders FROM dw.FactReviews WHERE ReviewScore BETWEEN 1 AND 5
query_sql.review_timeliness: SELECT CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=1 THEN 'On Time' WHEN o.IsOnTime=0 THEN 'Late' ELSE 'Not Eligible' END Timeliness,COUNT(*) ValidReviews,AVG(CONVERT(decimal(20,10),r.ReviewScore)) AverageScore FROM dw.FactReviews r JOIN dw.FactOrders o ON o.OrderKey=r.OrderKey WHERE r.ReviewScore BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=1 THEN 'On Time' WHEN o.IsOnTime=0 THEN 'Late' ELSE 'Not Eligible' END
query_sql.delivery_by_month_state: SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(10),o.PurchaseTimestamp,23),7) Month,c.SourceState State,COUNT(*) DeliveredOrders,SUM(CONVERT(int,o.OnTimeEligible)) OnTimeEligible,SUM(CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OnTimeOrders,SUM(CASE WHEN o.IsOnTime=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LateOrders,AVG(o.DeliveryDurationDays) AverageDurationDays FROM dw.FactOrders o JOIN dw.DimOrderStatus s ON s.OrderStatusKey=o.OrderStatusKey JOIN dw.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey=o.CustomerKey WHERE s.OrderStatus='delivered' GROUP BY LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(10),o.PurchaseTimestamp,23),7),c.SourceState
query_sql.reviews_by_month_state: SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(10),r.ReviewCreationTimestamp,23),7) Month,c.SourceState State,COUNT(*) ValidReviews,AVG(CONVERT(decimal(20,10),r.ReviewScore)) AverageScore FROM dw.FactReviews r JOIN dw.DimCustomer c ON c.CustomerKey=r.CustomerKey WHERE r.ReviewScore BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY LEFT(CONVERT(varchar(10),r.ReviewCreationTimestamp,23),7),c.SourceState
query_sql.review_scores: SELECT ReviewScore,COUNT(*) Reviews FROM dw.FactReviews WHERE ReviewScore BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY ReviewScore ORDER BY ReviewScore
